# Tag Scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TagScheme`](gmeow-TagScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TagScheme>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/tags`](../../slices/tags.md)

A namespaced set of tags — a project vocabulary, a personal tag bucket, or a controlled vocabulary. Multi-tenant: many schemes coexist, and a tag may belong to zero or more schemes ([`gmeow:tagInScheme`](../properties/gmeow-tagInScheme.md)). The counterpart of [skos:ConceptScheme](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#ConceptScheme) and [schema:DefinedTermSet.](https://schema.org/DefinedTermSet.)

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TagScheme`](gmeow-TagScheme.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
